'''''Darth Vader''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It depicted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Behind the scenes==
The painting was a lootable, nontradable item acquirable by redeeming the TCG card Painting: Darth Vader.
